mapper.select: SELECT meetings_id, host_id, status, meeting_mode FROM tl_meetings WHERE meetings_id = #{meetingId} LIMIT 1

SELECT tag_id, tag_name, color_code, is_active, display_order, created_at, updated_at FROM tl_tags
WHERE is_active = 1
ORDER BY COALESCE(display_order, 999999), tag_id

SELECT m.tag_id, m.meeting_id, m.created_by_user_id, m.created_at, m.updated_at, t.tag_name, t.color_code, t.is_active FROM tl_meetings_tag m JOIN tl_tags t ON t.tag_id = m.tag_id WHERE m.meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY COALESCE(t.display_order, 999999), t.tag_id
SELECT tag_id FROM tl_meetings_tag WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY tag_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tl_meetings_tag (meeting_id, tag_id, created_by_user_id) VALUES (#{meetingId}, #{tagId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
